Package dev.px.core.test.example

Class ExampleBrokenElement

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.test.example.ExampleBrokenElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
HudElement, Named
public final class ExampleBrokenElement extends Object implements HudElement
Throws on demand.

Exists to prove the thing you only find out about in production: one badly written HUD element must not be able to take the whole overlay down with it.

    • getId

      public String getId()
      Description copied from interface: HudElement
      Stable identity, used as the config key and the registry key.

      Must not change between builds: renaming it orphans every saved layout for this element. Keep it lowercase and separate from the display label, which is free to change.

      Specified by:
      getId in interface HudElement

    • getPreferredSize

      public Size getPreferredSize()
      Description copied from interface: HudElement
      Current natural size.

      Expected to differ every frame. A clock is wider at 12:00 than 1:00, an ArrayList grows as modules are toggled. Nothing caches this, and the anchor formula makes a size change move the element in the right direction on its own.

      Specified by:
      getPreferredSize in interface HudElement

    • render

      public void render(float x, float y, float w, float h)
      Description copied from interface: HudElement
      Draws the element with its top-left corner at (x, y).

      w and h are the natural size reported by HudElement.getPreferredSize() this frame, not the scaled size: any scale factor is already applied as a transform around this call.
